opening: I'm quite short of breath; it's hard to breathe.
I get palpitations; my heart races or beats irregularly.
Recently I've had numbness, loss of feeling or tingling in both arms and both legs and around my mouth.

opening.text: I'm quite short of breath; it's hard to breathe. I also get palpitations where my heart races or beats irregularly. Recently I've had numbness, loss of feeling or tingling in both arms and both legs and around my mouth. I feel anxious, and I suffer from chronic anxiety.
